sanskrit_verse: यदि शूद्रो नेता स्यात् तं क्लैब्येनालंकारेण अलंकृत्य शवभस्मना । मुखं विलिप्याग्रेयस्य पशोः शोणितेनोरसि पञ्चाङ्गुलानि कृत्वा ग्रीवायाम् । अन्त्राणि प्रतिमुच्य स्वेन पाणिना सीमालोष्टं मूर्ध्नि धारयेत् ॥
transliteration: yadi śūdro netā syāt taṃ klaibyenālaṃkāreṇa alaṃkṛtya śavabhasmanā | mukhaṃ vilipyāgreyasya paśoḥ śoṇitenorasi pañcāṅgulāni kṛtvā grīvāyām | antrāṇi pratimucya svyena pāṇinā sīmāloṣṭaṃ mūrdhni dhārayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If a Shudra assumes the role of leader, he shall be adorned with impotence as ornament, his face smeared with corpse-ash, the five fingers marked with the blood of the foremost beast upon his chest, and casting forth his entrails by his own hand, he shall carry a clod of earth upon his head.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is not determined by birth alone but by alignment with Dharma
Causation arises from conscious assumption of roles beyond one's capacity
Capacity-based responsibility mandates alignment with inherent nature
Restoration logic demands visible acknowledgment of misaligned action
Consciousness alignment requires purification through symbolic completion
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor.birth_category = 'Shudra' AND role.designation = 'leader' THEN initiate consciousness-realignment_protocol
IF role_misalignment_detected THEN execute symbolic_completion_process WITH elements: ash, blood, entrail-release, head-burden
IF capacity_exceeded(actor) THEN RESTORE_integrity THROUGH purification_sequencing
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a person of any varna assumes authority beyond their dharma-aligned capacity, the threshold of responsibility is not punitive but restorative. The court must ensure that such misalignment is corrected through consciousness-based protocols rather than punitive measures. Authority hierarchy is maintained by ensuring alignment with inherent capacity, not by birth alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that misaligned leadership creates sequential disruption in social harmony. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that improper assumption leads to visible disorder requiring conscious correction. Proportional responsibility lies in acknowledging the misstep through symbolic completion, not punishment. The non-punitive reality rule asserts that suffering is not justice; alignment is.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate symbolic purification sequence with ash and sacred markings
Execute voluntary acknowledgment protocol through physical representation of misalignment
Perform capacity restoration through guided withdrawal from inappropriate roles
Complete integrity reintegration via community witnessing and conscious reaffirmation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This law restores alignment through conscious acknowledgment, rejects punitive frameworks, and affirms that reality itself adjudicates through consciousness, not suffering.
